balls.text: gets an inside edge as he attempts to drive through the offside and short fine leg picks it up
squeezes out a full delivery down to cover and that brings up the 100
another yorker and he digs it back to the bowler

the over gets better for Agarkar! He fires an inswinging yorker which just hits the edge of the base of the legstump and the bail takes its own sweet time to get off the groove, Warne didn't pick the yorker
very close to being called a wide but Warne backed away
bowls the slow yorker outside off and the batsman makes room but fails to squeeze it out
swinging in on the stumps, he forces it through the line to long-off
excellent inswinging yorker, he can only dig it out back to the bowler
makes room and crashes a full delivery straight to long-off
gets an inside edge to the on side as he tries to drive square
he pushes it to midwicket and ambles through for the single, doesn't ground his bat
fires a length delivery outside off and Munaf fails to make contact as he tries to bludgeon it down the ground
swings and misses after making room and the keeper dives and fumbles with the ball
chips down the ground and shapes to slam him over long-on but he gets a thick outside edge which drops in front of third man
full on the stumps and he drives down the ground to long-on
fullish outside off and he pushes it softly wide of mid-off
makes room and the bowler fires it on the stumps, the ball just flicks the pads slightly and flattens the legstump
he makes room and slices him high over cover and Shukla goes for the catch and falls forward, the ball dips and drops in front of him
very welcome boundary as he reaches out and gets a thick outside edge which beats the keeper and runs away to third man
makes a bit of room and pushes a low full toss to deep cover
swings it on the pads and warne whips it straight to short fine leg, he ambles out of his crease but the throw is just wide of the stumps at his end
chips down the track andsqueezes it down to deep cover
another excellet yorker and there's little warne could do apart from digging it back to the bowler
starts off with an inswinging yorker and Warne digs it out to mid-off
Warne covers his stumps and flicks him off the pads and places it behind square on the on side
drives on the up wide of cover, Agarkar's there at the boundary to pick it up
opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man
tucks a slower ball to midwicket and Jadeja gets off the blocks but turns around
swishes outside the offstump and misses, no foot movement by Warne
he pushes a low full toss just wide of short cover, Ganguly fires the throw at the boundary
pushes it in front of mid-on and sets off quickly but there's an overthrow at the keeper's end, the over enthusiasm in the field gets a little too much for Kolkata
nice yorker on the legstump and he squeezes it down to fine leg
opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man
he scoops a low full toss down to long-off and the fielder has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end, the ball deflects off the stumps and they take an overthrow
keeps it on the stumps and Jadeja can only force it back to the bowler
bowls a full toss wide outside off and he reaches out but fails to make contact
skids through and the ball beats the bat just inches outside the offstump
tucks him up for room again as he opens the face of the bat and tries to squirt it past point
slower ball and he dabs it in front of point and sets off for a fairly easy single
aims for the inswinging yorker but it's a low full toss which Warne pushes to long-off
it's short and he meets the ball in front of his pace and pulls wide of square leg, there's protection at the boundary
stays rooted to the crease to flay a wide delivery and he can only chop it wide of slip
full and swinging in, he squeezes it out to cover
drives a full and wide delivery down to sweeper cover and the timing is crisp, an inspired Sarkar does well to pick it up and fire a flat throw
plays all over a fast yorker, the ball rolls to silly point but the non-striker was already off the blocks to complete the single
cramps him for room as he steers it to the off side
short and wide and not much pace on that ball, it sits up nicely as he cuts past backward point, third man cannot cut it off
full and on the stumps and Warne pushes it down to wide mid-off
short outside off and he punches it towards cover point
bounces him outside off and he lets it go
clips it to the on side and tells his partner to stay back
squirts out an inswinging yorker to the on side

terrible cricket from Rajasthan and Kolkata are loving this! He tucks it down to midwicket and sets off for a non-existent single, Henderson was always struggling and he wasn't quick enough for Hussey's direct hit
slower ball and he tucks it back to the bowler
it's a low full toss and he punches it right back to the bowler

it gets worse for Rajasthan! Yusuf takes a few paces down the pitch and squirts out a full delivery down to silly point, there's hesitation in the running but Yusuf sets off anyway, Dinda gathers the ball and breaks the stumps at the stro/iker's end and Yusuf, who turns around, is nowhere near the crease
pushes a slower ball to mid-on but the batsmen hesitate on seeing the fielder charge on the ball
keeps it on the offstump and he punches it back to the bowler
punches it past backward point
punches it to the off side
full on the stumps and he mistimes the drive and takes a single to wide long-on
bends down to avoid another bouncer but the umpire penalises him
aims for the inswinging yorker and he nearly falls over after working it to mid-on
he bowls him a bouncer but its not wide enough down the leg side for it to be called a wide
drops it short and he lets the ball sail past his body
Ganguly takes the catch at mid-on! Patel fails to control the pull off a short ball and the ball is skied to Ganguly's left, he covers a bit of ground and falls over after taking the catch
opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
picks the slower ball and steers it with soft hands in front of point and sets off, good calling
pulls him squarer this time and fine leg, who's quite square, runs to his right and stops it
another short delivery and he pulls along the turf, Ganguly picks it up in the region of long leg
drops it a fraction short and Patel pulls past square leg but the bowler has protection at the boundary
he pitches it up on the offstump and Yusuf scoops it down towards long-on
angles it on the body and he works it away to fine leg
whips him on the up but the ball drops safely in front of mid-on, they pick up a single
flays at a delivery outside the offstump and fails to make contact, his feet were nailed to the crease
plays a punchy drive off the backfoot and Sarkar at sweeper cover runs across and picks it up
bowls him the bouncer and he swishes hard at thin air, had he got a touch it would have travelled
driftys on the pads and he works it on its way to fine leg off the pads
directs the short ball close to the body and he adjusts by swaying backwards and dabbing it down to third man
he shows the full face of the bat and punches him past the vacant cover region cover region but Yashpal is at sweeper cover to mop up
143.5 kph, Dinda's working up a lot of pace, the ball kicks up and beats the edge as Patel tries to punch him
drops it short and he ducks and lets it pass to the keeper
keeps it dead straight on the stumps and Patel can only tap it back to the bowler
stands tall and punches it to the offside
Patel is caught unawares by the extra bounce as he hops and fends it off, the ball balloons off the handle and drops in the gap between slip and point
short and wide and he follows the height of the ball by slicing it over the region of third slip, third man's not around to cut it off
pushed back to the bowler
wide outside off and Yusuf has a waft at it
timber! Botha walks across his stumps to force it through the on side but he swings too early and gets a thick onside edge which cannons onto off and middle stumps
Botha reads the length very early, swivels and biffs a short delivery over midwicket's reach, the fielder made an attempt at catching it
just a bit of late swing and he punches it straight to backward point
steers a short delivery down to point and Patel takes a few paces out of his crease and quickly sprints back
on the middle stump and he tucks it down to midwicket, they refuse the single
short and a touch too wide and he upper cuts it wide of the slips, Ganguly does well at third man to slide and cut it off
just drifts on the body and he shuffles and tucks it wide of short fine leg, Sarkar gives the chase and makes a good attempt at the boundary
punches it straight to short cover
skids on his pads and Patel gets trapped on the legs but outside the line of legstump
skids through outside the offstump and he opens the face of the bat and angles it wide of slip, third man is very square and that's four
bowls it short and he lets this one go
keeps it short and he gets his elbows high and defends

Shoaib Shaikh pulls off a stunner! Langeveldt gets the ball to kick up and Ojha pokes his bat out for a half-hearted cut and gets a thick outside edge, the ball drifts away from Shaikh's right but he leaps and pulls off the catch one handed
Langeveldt tests him out again as he gets the ball to nip back and sneak past the outside edge
he beats him outside the off stump, a very half hearted cut attempted
pushes it to the off side

awesome fielding by Dinda! Asnodkar hops to fend off a delivery aimed at his body and the ball drops in front of silly point, Asnodkar sets off, Ojha does the same but changes his mind, a confused Asnodkar turns around and tries to head back but Dinda sprints, dives and in one motion affects the direct hit, no need for the third umpire
taps it to the off side and calls quickly for the run
strays too wide outside off and he reaches out and lets it go
skids through and he ends up thumping it back to the bowler without conviction
bangs it in short and tucks him up as he pushes it to the on side
this lands on a crack and shoots through pretty low, the ball just stopped on Ojha as he tried to slam it through the offside
that's a wild swish and a miss, rush of blood from the batsman as he tries to hook a bouncer
the testing over continues as he bangs it in short and Asnodkar bends his knee a bit and lets it go
lands it on a good length outside off and he safely shoulders arms
strays on the pads and he whips him on the up over square leg
gets good bounce and carry outside off, he lets it go
and Langeveldt strikes in his first ball, he bangs it in short and Quiney tries to hook him but gets a thick top edge and the keeper jogs to his right and takes the sitter
that's 22 off the over! Ojha gets on his knee and repeats the shot of the first ball and slogs him  over deep square-leg
flighted outside off , he reaches out and places it to the off side
tosses it up outside off and he bends his knee and scoops it over long-off
Dropped Ojha goes for the repeat shot and ends up getting a thick top edge and Hussey fluffs it at square leg
Ojha goes high and maximum! Talk about intent, he gets on his knee and slogs him over deep square-leg, terrific
he stays back and biffs one to deep mid-on and they take the run, the throw is side and Rajasthan have been knocked out of the tournament
Agarkar calmly steers it to point and they take a run, Jadeja';s throw is wide to the bowler's end and a slight fumble by the fielder backing up costs an extra run
Ojha fluffs another one! They steal another bye and Ojha misses the stumps at the batsman's end by a ,mile, he needs to get those gloves off
close! He swings and misses and they go for the bye, Ojha is caught in 2 minds where to throw, the ball sails over the stumps with the batsman a couple of yard short
full on the stumps and he squirts it to cover
he checks his loft to long-off, goof thinking because the fielder was up front from the rope
good comeback! It's a yorker on middle stump and Shukla manages to dig it out
take that! Another slower ball but it's a half volley, he makes room and scythes it over extra cover
slower ball and he doesn't pick it, the ball rolls to the keeper
it's a low full toss on middle and leg and he turns it away to midwicket for a single
out of the ground! Can we have the ball back please! He stays at the crease and slogs him high over deep midwicket
single to square leg
close! He slogs Botha and the ball dips in front of the fielder at deep midwicket, he may have lost it in the sunlight
stays back and he pushes it to long-on
lands on leg and he works it to midwicket
wide outside off and the bowler is penalised despite the batsman backing away
this one skids through and he just manages to get some bat on it
rocks back and slaps it hard down to sweeper cover
makes room to drive inside out but the ball comes on straight, the inside edge rolls past the stumps
he chips down the track and checks the loft to long-on
fired in quicker and Shukla gets his bat behind to defend
he paddles it away fine and it looks like four but the athletic Raut restricts it to a couple
stays back and defends to the off side
gets across and paddles it down to fine leg, the fielder is too square
he makes room and drives hard to deep extra cover, Amit Singh chucks a flat throw and it's a direct hit at the bowler's end, the batsman is safe though
he makes a lot of room and lofts Jadeja inside out high over extra cover, the ball just lands inches in front of the rope, very welcome boundary
makes room, Henderson bowls a wide one and Agarkar chases it and fails to get bat on ball
shuffles and works it to midwicket for another single
strays on the pads and he shuffles and clips it wide of fine leg, they pick up a couple
keeps it on a good length and he taps it to the off side
squeezes it with soft hands to the off side and sets off
flighted on middle and leg, he works it behind square on the on side
quicker through the air, he punches it down to midwicket
flighted on middle and leg and he forces it down to midwicket
turns away late and he defends
pushes it back down the track and jadeja shows good presence of mind by back flicking the ball towards the stumps, had he hit the batsman would have been in big trouble
flighted on middle and off, he defends with a dead bat
clips it against the turn to the on side
shuffles and clips it to the on side
appeal! He comes forward and and tries to defend and it's a good shout for an lbw
what a relief for Kolkata! He gets on his knee and slogs him over deep midwicket, and finally someone crosses double figures
comes down the track and pushes it with the line to long-off
flighted on middle and leg and turnd
pushed with the turn to midwicket

what on earth is happening today? Shukla tucks it in front of midwicket and there never really should have been a run there, Shaikh charges halfway down, turns back but the throw is fired to Botha who breaks the stumps, Shaikh's quite upset with his partner as he walks back. In fact Shukla didn't even want the single
pushes a full delivery through the line to long-on
flighted on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
just gets behind the line and defends on the front foot
lunges forward and beats cover
he commits forward, waits for the ball to come onto him and dabs it away very late, he manages to beat the gap between gully and backward point
tossed up on middle and leg, he tucks it to square leg
lunges forward and pushes it to the off side

appeal for a stumping, he draws the batsman forward and the ball spins away and beats him, Ojha whips off the bails, it appeared as if a part of the boot was behind the line and he gets the benefit of the doubt
quicker through the air and off the pitch, he stays back and defends with a dead bat
rare full toss but he ends up forcing it back to the bowler
slower through the air, he taps it towards midwicket
flighted on middle and leg and he works it to the on side
pushes it quicker and he's beaten on the drive
The KKR choke continues! Botha drops it short and gets some extra bounce, Hussey bends his knee for a front foot pull and the ball lands down Neeraj Patel's throat at deep midwicket
gets forward and pushes it with the turn to mid-off
Dropped Warne bowls the meanest flipper, he gets a thick edge and Ojha's reflexes weren't good enough
pushes it with the turn to the off side
defends with soft hands and the inside edge trickles past the keeper
stays back and punches with the turn to mid-off
starts off with a half tracker and he pulls it down to long-on
gets across and works it towards midwicket
beats him again! Botha's getting it to shoot up
goes right across his stumps and paddle scoops it over the keeper, it looked like a top edge but it was a very safe shot in the end
stays back and defends with a dead bat
spin, bounce and turn! That just shot up alarmingly and beat the bat

brilliant stuff by Ojha! Hodge drops the ball in front of silly point and takes off but the ball spins backwards to the keeper, Ojha flicks it back at the stumps and Hodge's bat was over the line but in the air, the third umpire takes a look
once again cramps him for room, the ball rolls towards cover, excellent spell by Munaf
short of a length and gets it to angle away slightly, once again he cannot pierce the packed off side field
gets beside the line and taps it down to cover
gets forward and taps it wide of cover with soft hands and takes off for a well-judged single
probes away outside off and the batsman watchfully lets it go
cramps him for room, he taps it firmly towards cover
punches him firmly down to mid-off
lands it on a good length on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
sways backwards to evade a bouncer
cuts off room and Hussey taps it back to the bowler
he dishes out a half volley on the pads and Hussey whips it away to the vacant spaces at  fine leg, Singh wasn't bowling to his field
streaky! He drives a full delivery and gets a thick outside edge which rolls past first slip and races away

Yashpal's misely ends and Rajasthan are really making a game of this! Munaf bangs it in short outside off and an under pressure Yashpal can't resist the upper cut, the ball dips in front of Quiney but he times his dive well and pulls it off inches from the turf, the extra ball has worked to Rajasthan's favour
chops it down to the off side and Warne leaps at gully to intercept it
pushes it through the line to mid-off
Free Hit A straightforward edge to the keeper and first slip gets excited, it's a free hit remember?
it's an overstep as well as a bouncer, don't think he could have played a shot
gets his elbows high and punches it straight to Jadeja at backward point, there are several blue shirts patrolling the off side ring
gets that steep bounce to trouble the right hander, he wafts at the ball and misses
taps it back to the bowler
biffs a short delivery across the line and the ball scorches to Munaf at deep square-leg
gets a half prod forward and taps it with soft hands to cover
quicker ball on the pads and he whips him straight to Munaf at deep square-leg
slower ball on the pads and Hodge picks the yawning gap well as he works it to fine leg, there's nobody patrolling the area
angles it on the pads and he work it down to midwicket
a mere defensive push is enough to beat mid-off, Henderson gives the chase at the boundary, good over all the same
the frustration gets to him as he makes room to slice him over backward point, Munaf gets extra bounce and beats him
bangs it in short outside off and he allows it to go through to the keeper
keeps it in the channel outside off and he taps it to the off side again
flashes outside the offstump and the extra bounce squares him up
on a good length and cramps him for room, he taps it to the off side and tells his partner to stay put
clips it to the on side, good comeback over for Rajasthan
gets beside the line and steers it towards gully, Pathan and another fielder at gully collide and Pathan (well) jumps over the other fielder
good length outside off and he steers it to the off side
prods forward and the ball just seams away and beats the bat

plumb! Man do we have a twist here? The ball lands close to the cracks on the surface just short of a good length and shoots through much lower than McCullum expects it to, he swings and misses and gets caught on the thigh in front of middle stump, his legs were bent at the point of contact
Ganguly takes a couple of paces down the pitch and makes room to slice it over the off side but he only manages hitting it straight to Jadeja at point who cups it and falls over backwards
hops and clips it towards the keeper
settles on a tight length on the offstump and Ganguly defends off the full face of the bat
almost squeezed it past the gap at backward point, excellent commitment by Jadeja
take that! He bangs it in short and wide and he rolls his wrists and slams it high over backward point
that's a freebie to start with, short on the body and he swivels and pulls it down to the vacant fine leg region
